review_cadence: weekly Monday and every stage gate

risks.title: P0 carrying value is not yet proven
risks.trigger: No measured repeat-carry or repeat-exploration improvement
risks.mitigation: Keep stages 4-6 blocked and run the P0 product experiment before cloud investment

risks.title: Catalog growth can overflow the factory partition
risks.mitigation: Stop adding compiled assets and require signed content packages or approved compression

risks.title: Catalog expansion can lose or hide old player progress
risks.trigger: Old catalog count differs from the current compiled catalog
risks.mitigation: Decode by stable species ID, initialize missing records, commit and read back before UI publication

risks.title: Official text and media may lack redistribution rights
risks.trigger: A candidate entry has missing or ambiguous license evidence
risks.mitigation: Quarantine the entry and ship only approved original or licensed content

risks.title: Hardware resource baseline is incomplete
risks.trigger: No current firmware size, minimum heap, DMA block, or physical-device trace
risks.mitigation: Record existing clean build and idle/reset evidence; track unfinished interactive heap and physical checks under the explicit 2026-09-17 owner deferral. Development/main publication is authorized; full device acceptance remains unverified.

risks.title: Premature microservices increase cost without user value
risks.trigger: Backend work starts before product and load gates pass
risks.mitigation: Enforce serial stage checker and require an explicit gate decision

risks.title: Backend, database, and SRE owners are not delegated
risks.trigger: A blocked stage is proposed for activation without named specialist DRIs
risks.mitigation: Name Backend, Database, SRE, QA, and privacy DRIs before changing stage status

risks.title: External source changes can silently alter catalog semantics
risks.trigger: Pinned source snapshot data hash changes
risks.mitigation: Require source diff, invariant checks, quarantine, and human review before production import

risks.title: Stage 3 proceeds with unfinished Stage 2 device acceptance
risks.trigger: Interactive soak, workload heap, physical storage-error controls or power-cut acceptance remain unfinished
risks.mitigation: Preserve the owner deferral and private backups; keep device acceptance unfinished, maintain host regression coverage, and resume deferred tests before claiming full device acceptance. Stages 4-6 remain blocked.
